newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daehan Flour seeks 24,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Daehan Flour seeks 24,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd invited tenders to buy 24,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Wednesday, traders said on Tuesday.

Traders said the total amount would be split into four postions -- 12,000 tonnes of western white/soft white, 1,000 tonnes of western white (club minimum 15 percent), 2,000 tonnes of hard red winter (protein minimum 11.5 percent), and 9,000 tonnes of dark northern spring (protein minimum 14 percent).
Shipment was set for May 15-June 15 to the western port of Inchon.
